title: Peace of Travendal
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Peace of Travendal", at revision 1377850504, opens: "The Peace of Travendal was a peace treaty concluded at the outset of the Great Northern War on 18 August 1700 between the Swedish Empire, Denmark–Norway and Holstein-Gottorp in Traventhal. Denmark had to return Holstein-Gottorp to its duke, a Swedish ally, and to leave the anti-Swedish alliance. The treaty was guaranteed by France, the Holy Roman Empire, the Dutch Republic, and the Kingdom of England." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q701663, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
